```{=html}
<div role="note" class="study-note" aria-label="Using these lessons"><div class="note-mark" aria-hidden="true">i</div><div><h2>Connect, differentiate and explain.</h2><p>Lesson 1 builds on the derivative of the natural exponential function. Rewrite other bases using the natural exponential, apply the chain rule, and combine exponential functions with products and quotients. Follow Examples 1.1–1.8 on pages 1–6 of the Differential Calculus booklet, then complete Homework 1 on page 7.</p><p>Lesson 2 derives the logarithmic rules and applies the chain, product and quotient rules. Follow Examples 2.1–2.8 on pages 8–14, then complete Homework 2 on page 15.</p><p>Lesson 3 explores trigonometric gradients and combines trigonometric derivatives with the chain, product and quotient rules. Follow Examples 3.1–3.11 on pages 16–25, then complete Homework 3 on page 26.</p></div></div>
```
